generation_versions.prompt: Make a color-only edit of this exact no-text technical drawing. Preserve EVERY component position, margin, scale, all grids/row and column counts, node counts, connectors, arrow direction, line endpoints, layer glyphs and label whitespace. Never redraw its topology or rearrange content. Apply the palette to EVERY colored frame, fill, circle, bar, arrow and line; leave NO original high saturation pigment. Blue/cyan becomes muted #7188A3 and #E5EAF0; green #829C8B/#E8EEE9; yellow/orange #B4A16F/#F1ECDD; red/pink #A7787D/#F0E5E6; purple #9588A5/#ECE8F0. Use blue for main generic modules/output, red only for errors/loss or an indispensable distinct series. Ordinary boxes rounded about 6px. Background pure white; neutral wires #556170. No shadows, texture, gradients, letters, numbers, or pseudo text. Preserve exact canvas aspect ratio and all empty label spaces. Preserve natural input images and data point relations. All graph node circles use the SAME muted blue style; keep scientifically distinct node roles muted green/yellow sparingly.
